issues.description: The problem text explicitly instructs students to use a StringBuilder for the Animal name attribute, but the UML in the problem statement shows name: String and the provided solution implements name as a String. This inconsistency leaves students unclear whether the name field should be a String or a StringBuilder and may cause confusion when writing constructors, getters, and setters (and when matching expected test signatures).
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the specification: either (A) update the problem statement/UML to require a String (remove the StringBuilder directive) so all artifacts consistently use String for the name, or (B) change the template and solution to use a StringBuilder field type (and adjust constructors/getters/setters accordingly). Prefer option (A) for simplicity unless teaching StringBuilder usage is intentional — in that case update the UML and provided solution/template to use StringBuilder.

issues.description: The problem text explicitly instructs that the Animal 'name' attribute should use StringBuilder for efficient modifications, but the UML in the problem shows 'name: String' and the provided solution implements 'private String name' in Animal.java. This discrepancy between the textual requirement (StringBuilder) and both the UML and the solution (String) creates a conflicting specification that will confuse students about the expected type and the required getter/setter signatures.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the specification and implementation. Either (A) update the problem statement and UML to require a String 'name' (remove the StringBuilder requirement), or (B) change the Animal implementation to use a StringBuilder field: declare 'private StringBuilder name;', initialize it in the constructor with 'this.name = new StringBuilder(name);', and update the getter/setter signatures and all call sites (e.g., subclasses using getName()) accordingly (e.g., provide getName() returning StringBuilder or a String via name.toString()). Ensure the UML, problem text, template, and solution consistently specify the same type.
